description: Fetch a single Instagram post or reel by URL — both /p/{shortcode}/ and /reel/{shortcode}/ are accepted (reels are normalized to /p/ and structurally posts). Returns the full caption, author, like/comment counts, timestamp, and media URLs. Pass --include_comments true to also load the comment thread; nested replies ("view all N replies") are expanded automatically and count toward --comment_limit. Requires a logged-in Instagram session.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Post or reel URL: instagram.com/p/{shortcode}/, instagram.com/{user}/p/{shortcode}/ or instagram.com/reel/{shortcode}/. The shortcode is extracted and the reel form is normalized to /p/.

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: Set to true to also return comments. Default false. Comments paginate and nested replies expand one by one, so enabling this is noticeably slower on popular posts.

parameters.name: comment_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of comments to return (1-100, default 20), counting nested replies toward the total. Only used when include_comments is true.
